purpose: Define the logical source-to-C11 admission boundary without selecting a storage engine, codec, index, cache, or source-retirement policy.

requirements: Pin exact source artifact identity/hash and release identity before semantic normalization.
Reject latest/default/path-only source selection.
Retain source snapshot reference; ingest success does not authorize retirement.
Construct exact EmpiricalUniverse identity from raw source/study/release/instrument/geography/wave/time/sample-frame/design/respondent namespace facts.
Canonical aliases never replace raw universe identity.
Unknown universe fields are explicit typed states or exact authority refs, never omitted semantic meaning.
Scope every respondent key to one exact universe.
Normalized respondent IDs require explicit bijective identity-map authority.
Cross-universe string equality grants no linkage.
Bind native question/variable/component/version to immutable semantic and topology authority.
Do not assume scalar singularity from observed row counts.
Canonical question identity is optional only with typed absence when no authority exists.
Emit one logical RespondentEvent per governed occurrence/component required by source topology.
Preserve event group, multiplicity index, semantic ordinal/rank, raw value, canonical value authority, and typed response state.
Never deduplicate events merely because respondent/question/value fields match.
Represent respondent-question applicability/risk-set incidence explicitly or by an exact deterministic replay rule plus all parent inputs.
Equal denominators do not establish identical risk sets.
A missing response row cannot stand in for not-asked/IAP/not-applicable state.
Emit respondent-bound conditionable coordinate facts over the future-authorizable frontier, not only current fixed V550 fields.
Preserve native coordinate identity/value/time and canonical crosswalk authority when present.
Do not map coordinate labels to generated structural position.
Bind each governed weight to respondent, basis, source variable, design/estimand authority, validity state, and recalibration rule when applicable.
Missing or invalid governed weights remain typed unavailable; generic 1.0 fill is forbidden.
Raw measure remains independently reconstructible.
Every semantic transform/routing/topology/weight/crosswalk/predicate/comparator/discovery/admission authority is immutable ID/version/hash addressed.
Universes remain distinct by default; pooling, linkage, overlap treatment, harmonization, backfill and deduplication are separate authority claims.
Provenance or shared canonical labels never imply composition authority.
Compute semantic projection identity covering all M01-M18 proof-relevant fields.
Bind frontier version, authority snapshot set, exact source content refs, deterministic tie/order rules, and replay protocol version.
Reject manifest if any required ref is missing, mutable, ambiguous, hash-mismatched, or cyclic without exact closure semantics.
Publish the source release into C11 only after all mandatory M01-M18 coverage checks pass.
Partial physical presence is not partial semantic authority.
Failure returns typed ingest disposition and leaves no package declared C11-authoritative.

fail_closed_rules: No fuzzy/latest/default/nearest authority or source selection.
No inferred source pooling or respondent linkage from alias, provenance, location, or matching identifiers.
No scalar collapse where topology permits multiselect/repeat/rank/order/component events.
No missing-row encoding for a semantically typed absence state.
No default weight, topology, routing, canonical value, or source relation.
No semantic authority from storage presence, cache presence, index presence, or successful parsing.
No empirical-coordinate to structural/generated-position promotion at ingest.
No query/discovery/structural-admission semantics synthesized by the C11 carrier.
No source-retirement claim from successful ingest alone.
equivalence_requirement: A source/release may be declared equivalent to C11 only by a later positive source-equivalence proof spanning every M01-M18 distinction and applicable D13B P01-P20 replay dimension; schema/count/aggregate/selected-query parity is insufficient.
